Fields keep their raw unit strings; `deckifyr.schema.units.parse_length`
converts them to EMUs during plan resolution, not here.

Element.description:
One element, as it appears in either a layout or a slide override.

`id` is optional here because layouts.yaml and presentation.yaml's
dict-keyed slide forms (spec section 7.6's `elements: {title: ...}`)
use the mapping key as the id; only the list-keyed freeform form
(`elements: [{id: ..., ...}]`) sets it inline. Every field besides
`type` is optional so an override can touch only what it changes,
per the merge precedence in spec section 7.2.

id.description: Element id; only needed in list-form `elements`, where there is no mapping key.
id.title: Id

type.description: What kind of element this is. Required once, then optional on overrides.
type.title: Type

value.description: The element's content: text, Markdown, a magic string, or a path, depending on `type`.
value.title: Value

source.description: File the element reads from, such as an image path or a table `.csv`/`.parquet`.
source.title: Source

box.description: Position and size on the slide.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, clockwise, around the box centre.
rotation.title: Rotation

z_index.description: Stacking order; higher values paint on top.
z_index.title: Z Index

center.description: Vertically centre text within the box.
center.title: Center

align.description: Horizontal text alignment within the box.
align.title: Align

table_style.description: `table` only: `table_styles` name controlling fill and borders.
table_style.title: Table Style

fit.description: `image` only: how the picture fills its box.
fit.title: Fit

overflow.description: What to do when content does not fit the box.
overflow.title: Overflow

render_mode.description: `quarto` only: how a fragment is rendered (native text, or a picture).
render_mode.title: Render Mode

alt_text.description: Accessible description for pictures and shapes.
alt_text.title: Alt Text

remove.description: On a slide override: drop this layout element from the slide.
remove.title: Remove

required.description: Fail the build if this element ends up without content.
required.title: Required

footer_placement.description: `reportifyr` and `{rpfy}:` tables: where the source/notes footer goes.
footer_placement.title: Footer Placement

elements.description: `group` only: child elements, keyed by id or listed with their own `id`.
elements.title: Elements

FlextableConfig.description:
Execution settings for rendering a reportifyr `.rds` artifact --
an R `flextable` object (issue #57) -- to a picture via
`deckifyr.renderers.flextable`. Nested under `ReportifyrConfig`
rather than a `QuartoConfig`/`PreviewConfig`-style top-level
`BuildConfig` sibling: unlike Quarto/preview rendering (each
triggered by its own distinct element type), flextable rendering
only ever exists to serve a `reportifyr` element whose resolved
artifact happens to be `.rds`. `None` on `ReportifyrConfig.flextable`
(the default) means every setting below's own default -- read
lazily by `deckifyr.pptx.compose._build_reportifyr_context`, only
when a build actually resolves an `.rds` reportifyr artifact.

binary.description: The `Rscript` binary: a bare name looked up on PATH, or a full path.
binary.title: Binary

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a render after this many seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

max_output_bytes.description: Reject a rendered picture larger than this.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

dpi.description: Render resolution in dots per inch.
dpi.title: Dpi

FlextableConfig.title: FlextableConfig

status.description: Free-text status such as draft or final; also the default status-mark text.
status.title: Status

PreviewConfig.description:
Tuning knobs for slide preview rendering (spec section 12/18 Phase
3), mirroring `QuartoConfig`'s own "`None` means every default
applies" shape -- `previews: true` below is the on/off switch; this
block only matters once that (or an explicit `deckifyr preview`
invocation) actually triggers a render.
`deckifyr.renderers.preview.render_slide_previews` shells out to
LibreOffice for real PowerPoint-engine fidelity, so `binary` is a
bare name resolved via PATH by default, or a full path for a
non-PATH install -- same convention as `QuartoConfig.binary`.

binary.description: The LibreOffice `soffice` binary: a bare name looked up on PATH, or a full path.
binary.title: Binary

dpi.description: Preview image resolution in dots per inch.
dpi.title: Dpi

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a preview render after this many seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

PreviewConfig.title: PreviewConfig

QuartoConfig.description:
Execution settings for `type: quarto` elements (spec section 8.1,
issue #3), project-relative to `presentation.yaml` where a path is
involved. `None` on `BuildConfig.quarto` (the default) means every
setting below's own default -- read lazily by
`deckifyr.pptx.compose`'s `_build_quarto_context`, only when a build
actually contains a `quarto` element, same as `ReportifyrConfig`.

binary.description: The `quarto` binary: a bare name looked up on PATH, or a full path.
binary.title: Binary

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a render after this many seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

max_output_bytes.description: Reject rendered output larger than this.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

QuartoConfig.title: QuartoConfig

ReportifyrConfig.description:
Where/how to resolve `{rpfy}:` magic strings (spec section 9.1),
project-relative paths. `standard_footnotes` is required only
lazily -- a build with no `reportifyr`/rpfy-sourced element never
reads it; `deckifyr.pptx.compose` raises a `ContentValidationError`
if one exists and this is unset.

outputs_dir.description: Project-relative folder searched recursively for `{rpfy}:` artifacts.
outputs_dir.title: Outputs Dir

standard_footnotes.description: Project-relative `standard_footnotes.yaml`; only read once an element needs a footer.
standard_footnotes.title: Standard Footnotes

fail_on_missing_metadata.description: Fail the build when an artifact has no metadata sidecar.
fail_on_missing_metadata.title: Fail On Missing Metadata

flextable.description: Settings for rendering `.rds` flextable artifacts; unset uses the defaults.

ReportifyrConfig.title: ReportifyrConfig

layout.description: Layout name from `layouts.yaml`, or null for a freeform slide.

elements.description: Content and overrides, keyed by the layout's element ids, or a list for freeform slides.
elements.title: Elements

design.description: Which design document the deck uses.
